spec.section: # Runbook: controller restart during a send
## Trigger The controller exits, loses its connection, or fails readiness while a send is `queued`, `admitted`, `dispatched` or `await_report`.

## Do
1. Start in `recovering`; acquire `/chd/system/writer` with a fresh `boot_id` and external compare-and-set. If ownership is unknown, remain refused with `503 writer_lease_held_or_unknown`. 2. Require config validity, DuckBrain health and achieved `X-Durability: fsync` before dispatch. 3. Read canonical room heads/messages, manifests/attempts, reservations, run references, reports, bonds, tickets/events, datasets and audits. Re-derive worklists; never use an in-memory queue or board file as authority. 4. For `composed|queued|admitted`, re-drive the durable next step with the retained identity. For `dispatched`, reconcile the remote run before any POST. For `staging` datasets, mark failed and keep the report unpublished. 5. Re-register scheduler lanes and read them back before accepting callbacks. Resume only after all recovery writes and evidence reads succeed.

## Evidence Record boot id, writer lease revision, read prefixes, effective manifest revisions, run-status probes, action, final capacity decision and test `WF-07-CONTROLLER-RESTART`. The expected result is one logical `send_id`, one attempt and at most one gateway run.
## Never Do not reset `_head`, reclaim reserved sequence tails, infer that a missing response means no execution, or start a second worker from a failed process exit.
